notes: Reviewed nonpublication mutations: schema/adoption, irreversible privacy erasure/markers, bounded debt invalidation/disposal, and masked TEMP deletion selection. Gate-internal refusal/abandonment writes are part of authorization, not caller bypasses. Any change requires reviewing this inventory. CollectionFileCursor owns a private empty-filename SQLite manifest; its complete source digest pins the isolated adapter. Collection proof copies are restricted to SQLiteConnection temporary proof databases. Backfill progress marks (git_backfill_progress) only skip occurrences already offered to discovery; they never authorize a publication, and deleting the largest agent-log event id lowers them. Forget narrows its TEMP selection in the final unit so rows published in a batch gap are not cascaded. Finished-source receipts and the checkpoint-pass mark keep their value in the git_backfill_progress key (event_id 0) and likewise only skip work already offered. After narrowing, the final unit takes back only tombstones this forget added for rows that stay and are not in the range by themselves. Concatenated literals are joined before matching, and a non-literal operand is marked \\(+). A literal after a non-literal + operand, or one that starts with an interpolation, is marked \\(+) or kept as is when it still shows a statement tail (FROM, INTO, SET or git_); the reads this lists are rows/integer executions. A checkpoint pass saves its start as a write floor (a checkpoints:floor: key, event_id 0) before its first page, so later checkpoint writes stay above the mark it saves; saving the mark removes the floor.

schema_triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ax_probe_content_delete AFTER DELETE ON ax_probe_attempts BEGIN DELETE FROM ax_probe_parts WHERE attempt_row=OLD.id; DELETE FROM ax_probe_refs WHERE attempt_row=OLD.id; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ax_probe_content_refused AFTER UPDATE OF payload ON ax_probe_attempts WHEN json_extract(NEW.payload,'$.ax.status')='policyRefused' BEGIN DELETE FROM ax_probe_parts WHERE attempt_row=NEW.id; DELETE FROM ax_probe_refs WHERE attempt_row=NEW.id; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ax_probe_evidence_delete AFTER DELETE ON evidence BEGIN DELETE FROM ax_probe_attempts WHERE evidence_id=OLD.id; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ax_probe_attempt_delete AFTER DELETE ON ax_probe_attempts BEGIN DELETE FROM ax_probe_review WHERE attempt_row=OLD.id; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ax_probe_review_no_enable BEFORE INSERT ON settings WHEN NEW.key='general.axProbe.enabled' AND NEW.value='1' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM settings WHERE key='general.axProbe.reviewLease' AND json_valid(value) AND CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS REAL)>=json_extract(value,'$.issuedWall') AND CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS REAL)<json_extract(value,'$.deadlineWall')) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Close probe review first'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ax_probe_review_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON ax_probe_review WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ax_probe_review_state WHERE run_id=OLD.run_id AND sealed=1) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Review sealed'); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS intervals_no_overlap BEFORE INSERT ON intervals WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM intervals WHERE start_ts<NEW.end_ts AND end_ts>NEW.start_ts) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'One minute belongs to at most one interval'); END
